title: HealMed: Multilingual Evaluation of Large Language Models in Medicine
abstract: arXiv:2608.19981v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present HealMed, an expert-reviewed benchmark for multilingual evaluation of large language models in medicine. HealMed contains 1,000 examples in each of nine languages, drawn from nine datasets and covering three task formats: MCQA, NLI and open-ended QA. The benchmark was developed over two years by 23 physicians and medical experts based across nine countries and regions. Each translation was evaluated and revised by two experts fluent in English and the corresponding target language. On HealMed, performance declined most in low-resource languages, although the size of the gap varied markedly across languages and models. The strongest proprietary models were the most stable across languages, whereas many open-source and medically specialized models showed larger and less consistent gaps. translated_title: HealMed：医学领域大语言模型的多语言评估
translated_abstract: 我们提出了HealMed，一个由专家评审的医学领域大语言模型多语言评估基准。HealMed包含九种语言各1000个示例，这些示例来自九个数据集，涵盖三种任务格式：多项选择问答（MCQA）、自然语言推理（NLI）和开放式问答。该基准由来自九个国家和地区的23名医生和医学专家历时两年开发而成。每项翻译均由精通英语和相应目标语言的两位专家进行评估和修订。在HealMed上，低资源语言的性能下降最为显著，尽管不同语言和模型之间的差距大小差异明显。最强的专有模型在跨语言方面最为稳定，而许多开源和医学专用模型表现出更大且不一致的差距。医学专业化本身并不能确保多语言的鲁棒性。此外，专家修订可能提高或降低测量性能。
tldr: HealMed是一个由医学专家开发的多语言医学评估基准，揭示了低资源语言性能下降显著，且医学专业化并不能保证跨语言的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: HealMed is an expert-developed multilingual medical benchmark revealing significant performance drops in low-resource languages and showing that medical specialization alone does not ensure cross-lingual robustness.
